claim: Jacobs' biosolids O&M programs manage disposal and beneficial use of over 40,000 dry tons of solids every year.
Jacobs has designed hundreds of biosolids projects worldwide and completed more than 4,000 water and wastewater facilities.
David Oerke has evaluated or designed solids equipment for more than 120 municipalities nationwide.
Drew Mearns has 30+ years of sludge and biosolids-management experience nationwide.
Half of the dewatering capacity was inoperative because one Schwing screw press had a problem.
One centrifuge was inoperative during the environmental-campus site visit but appeared to be in regular maintenance.
JC Solutions will evaluate alternative beneficial-reuse opportunities in the first year.
Jacobs averages five mobile dewatering operations for emergency or temporary needs.
Jacobs secured a $9.8 million USDA grant for Tulsa to help offset a $45 million biosolids fertilizer manufacturing center.
Jacobs assisted Hendersonville, NC, to secure a $14.5 million principal-forgiveness grant for a drying facility.
Monthly Operating Reports showed no odor complaints in 2024.
Significant odor-control investments had been made at all three sites.
JC Solutions will make an off-site odor patrol once per shift during the known high-odor season.
The odor dispersion model uses site-specific hourly atmospheric conditions from the past five years.
The last odor study at the environmental-campus facility was performed in 2009.
